chapters.title: OneLake and Direct Lake in a nutshell

takeaways: OneLake gives Power BI, Synapse and Data Factory one governed store with Purview lineage and labels, so data is placed once and consumed without copies.
Enabling Fabric in the Power BI admin portal is a non-destructive unlock; test with a pilot group, a trial capacity and a sandbox workspace before production.
Reliable Dataflow Gen2 ingestion, pipelines with on-fail email alerts, and a clean star-schema semantic model in Direct Lake mode deliver fast, fresh and trustworthy reports.
hook: Many Power BI teams hesitate to switch on Microsoft Fabric because they fear breaking existing reports. This episode is for Power BI admins and data teams who want to understand OneLake and Direct Lake. It walks through enabling Fabric safely, feeding the lakehouse with Dataflow Gen2, automating pipeline alerts and modeling for Direct Lake.
